protocol.precision: float64 proxy and directional gradients; frozen float32 Student
protocol.runtime_scope: Cold independent child plus method-specific staging, input reads/hash checks, initialization, all required preparation, inference, transfers, full global forward/backward, projection, calibration, every failed/repair replay, CEC/mapping and persistence. Excludes queue, one-time build/source staging and analysis; no system page-cache flush.
protocol.budget_scope: Four replay requests including measured no-op, failures and explicit repairs. Original is an additional paid measurement, never a second zero-choice fit label. At most five ordinary mapping calls; extra cut-context CEC counted separately.
protocol.baseline_B_recipe: read_aiger original; strash; rewrite; write_aiger candidate; reload candidate with the common Evaluator
protocol.measurement: cec -n original candidate; read_lib ASAP7; read_aiger candidate; map; topo; stime -p; write_verilog mapped.v; ABC_SCL_LIBERTY from same SC_Man for global and every PO
protocol.original_fallback: Ours may return only its own paid original measurement if actual area is feasible and delay is lower than its successful search best. Never use externally measured A/B results for free.
protocol.undefined_ratios: Missing, failed, timed out or zero denominator => null/N/A. Log geometric mean includes only strictly positive defined ratios and reports its own denominator.
protocol.tradeoff_scope: All three methods successful and area feasible under Ours paid no-op reference; use predeclared delay/runtime tolerances and report a full delay-by-time relation grid.
protocol.resume: Keep completed terminal method records unchanged; resume missing points with the same source/tools/config/input/hardware, never select best repeat.
protocol.scope: Development-checked revision; source/tools/input/config must be frozen before this state can change to FROZEN. Exactly 905 inputs and 2715 terminal method points required; no random/greedy/legacy/native-CULS or joint comparison. A/B relative speed is not independent GPU causal acceleration.
